label: 🧪 HDF5
description: Read HDF5 files (.h5, .hdf5). Walks the group tree to find tabular datasets — picks the first 2-D dataset by default, or use the 'path' option to select a specific dataset by its in-file path (e.g. /experiment/run1/data). Requires the [science] extra (h5py).

path.label: Dataset path
path.help: In-file path to the dataset, e.g. /group/sub/dataset. Default: the first 2-D dataset found in depth-first order.
